title: Baba Ramdev ji Ramdevra Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Baba Ramdev ji: Ramsa Pir kyun?

scenes.prompt: Close-up darshan of a Baba Ramdev ji murti: a serene kind face with a mustache, a saffron turban with a gold border, a white and saffron robe, marigold garlands around the shoulders, a small brass diya in front, a quiet temple sanctum, warm golden glow, face in the middle of the frame
scenes.tts: बाबा रामदेव जी को रामसा पीर क्यों कहते हैं?
scenes.sub: Baba Ramdev ji ko Ramsa Pir kyun kehte hain?
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, the golden glow gently pulses

scenes.prompt: A peaceful Rajasthan desert village temple with a white and saffron shikhar, saffron flags fluttering, golden sand dunes around, morning light, a few devotees walking, wide view, no text
scenes.tts: रामदेवरा, जैसलमेर ज़िले का प्रसिद्ध धाम।
scenes.sub: Ramdevra, Jaisalmer zile ka prasiddh dham.
scenes.animate: saffron flags flutter gently, soft dust drifts over the sand, warm light shifts slowly

scenes.prompt: Darshan of the Baba Ramdev ji murti in a sanctum, saffron turban, white robe, marigold and rose garlands, a row of brass diyas glowing in front, slightly wider view, warm golden light, a few petals resting at the base
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, हिंदू-मुसलमान, दोनों उन्हें पूजते हैं।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, Hindu-Musalman, dono unhe poojte hain.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, many diya flames flicker softly, a few marigold petals drift in the background

scenes.prompt: Close-up of a pair of small carved footprint charan symbols on a marble platform, marigold petals and a brass diya beside them, soft warm temple light, shallow depth of field, no text
scenes.tts: भक्त चरण चिह्नों के आगे दीया जलाते हैं।
scenes.sub: Bhakt charan chinhon ke aage diya jalate hain.
scenes.animate: the diya flame flickers softly, a few marigold petals sway gently in the warm air

scenes.tts: जय बाबा रामदेव जी! अच्छा लगे तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें। जय बाबा रामदेव!
scenes.sub: Jai Baba Ramdev ji! Achha lage to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Jai Baba Ramdev!
